name: 37086 · La Vergne, TN
findings: ZIP 37086 (La Vergne) has 60 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (25%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 10 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37086 (La Vergne) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37086 (La Vergne) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 24% of the typical level).
